About

Our Dental Clinic

Smile Club makes quality dental care affordable for everyone — with or without insurance. Members enjoy exclusive savings, and year round peace of mind.

Spa-Like
Environment

Our patients love to visit our practice, not only for our preventative and cosmetic dentistry services but because we add comfort and luxury at every turn. Enjoy free Wi-Fi and complimentary coffee, tea, and bottled water while you relax before your appointment.

Customized, Quality
Dental Care

Our expertise and investment in the latest dental technology allow us to offer a higher level of care than ever before. Digital X-rays, intra-oral cameras, cone beam CT scanners, and other state-of-the-art technology means every patient receives customized care and beautiful, lasting results.
